title: Common definitions
description: Shared primitive definitions used by every Digital 3D contract. Owned jointly; changes require sign-off from every module owner listed in GOVERNANCE.md.

contract_version.description: Version of the shared contract set this document conforms to.

module_id.description: Identifier of an owning module, e.g. 'manhattan-bridge' or 'dumbo-district'.

asset_urn.description: Globally unique asset reference: urn:d3d:<module_id>:<local_id>. This is the ONLY way one module may refer to another module's asset.

confidence.description: Confidence grade. See source-confidence.schema.json. A is strongest, D is placeholder.

source_basis.description: How the geometry or value was obtained. Never empty.

hex_colour.description: An sRGB colour as #rrggbb. Deliberately a string rather than a triple: every consumer in this stack is a renderer, and every renderer parses this form.

lonlat.description: [longitude, latitude] in decimal degrees, WGS84. Longitude first, per GeoJSON (RFC 7946).

geodetic_position.description: A position on the Earth. WGS84 horizontal; the vertical value is expressed in the named vertical datum.

scene_position.description: A position in a named scene frame. Meters, right-handed, Z-up.

position.description: A position given either geodetically, in a scene frame, or by reference to a registered asset.

vertical_datum.description: Vertical reference surface. Producers MUST state this; consumers MUST convert via georeference.vertical_datum_offsets_m.

bbox_scene.description: Axis-aligned bounding box in a scene frame, meters.

bbox_geodetic.description: GeoJSON-style bbox: [west, south, east, north] with optional [.., minHeight, maxHeight] inserted per RFC 7946.

placement.description: Rigid placement of a module's local engineering frame inside a scene frame. Applied as: p_scene = translation + rotation * (scale * p_local).

yaw_deg.description: Convenience alternative to rotation_quat for the common case of a pure heading rotation about +Z. Rotation from the module's +X axis to scene East, measured counter-clockwise looking down.

scale.description: Uniform scale. MUST be 1 for georeferenced delivery. Non-unit values are reserved for display scales such as HO 1:87.1.

provisional.description: True when the placement has been proposed by a consumer and not yet ratified by the owning module. Provisional placements MUST NOT be treated as survey truth.

open_questions.description: IDs of unresolved questions in the owning module that block ratification, e.g. 'OQ-009'.

provenance.description: Who produced this document and from what.

generated_by.description: Script or agent identifier plus version.
